title: Smoky Chicken Skewers
description: Grilled chicken skewers with a smoky flavor, inspired by Canadian BBQ styles. Quick and easy to make, perfect for a summer evening.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix smoky seasoning with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Thread chicken legs onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush skewers with the smoky seasoning mixture, making sure to coat all the chicken evenly.
Grill skewers for 12-15 minutes, turning occasionally, until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Once cooked, let the skewers rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
